mapper.sql: SELECT d.id, d.document_no, d.kind, d.status, r.title, COALESCE(e.name, a.username) AS applicant, e.id AS applicant_employee_id, e.avatar_key AS applicant_avatar_key, r.department_name, r.amount, d.created_at, d.updated_at, COALESCE(ue.name, ua.username) AS operator, ue.id AS operator_employee_id, ue.avatar_key AS operator_avatar_key, r.submitted_at, t.id AS task_id, COALESCE(te.name, ta.username) AS assignee, te.id AS assignee_employee_id, te.avatar_key AS assignee_avatar_key, COALESCE(ae.name, aa.username) AS alternate, ae.id AS alternate_employee_id, ae.avatar_key AS alternate_avatar_key, t.due_at, p.paid_on FROM work_document d JOIN document_revision r ON r.id = d.current_revision_id JOIN account a ON a.id = d.owner_id LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id = a.employee_id LEFT JOIN account ua ON ua.id = d.updated_by LEFT JOIN employee ue ON ue.id = ua.employee_id LEFT JOIN approval_task t ON t.revision_id = r.id AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN account ta ON ta.id = t.assignee_id LEFT JOIN employee te ON te.id = ta.employee_id LEFT JOIN account aa ON aa.id = t.alternate_id LEFT JOIN employee ae ON ae.id = aa.employee_id LEFT JOIN expense_payment p ON p.document_id = d.id
mapper.select: WHERE d.owner_id = #{owner} ORDER BY d.id DESC

WHERE (t.id IS NOT NULL AND (t.assignee_id = #{account} OR t.alternate_id = #{account})) OR (d.kind IN ('EXPENSE', 'PURCHASE') AND d.status = 'AWAITING_PAYMENT') ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC, t.id DESC, d.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
WHERE (t.id IS NOT NULL AND (t.assignee_id = #{account} OR t.alternate_id = #{account})) OR (d.kind IN ('EXPENSE', 'PURCHASE') AND d.status = 'AWAITING_PAYMENT') ) inbox

SELECT e.id, d.id AS document_id, d.document_no, d.kind, d.status, r.title, COALESCE(ea.name, a.username) AS applicant, ea.id AS applicant_employee_id, ea.avatar_key AS applicant_avatar_key, e.action, e.comment, e.occurred_at AS handled_at, d.created_at, d.updated_at, COALESCE(oe.name, oa.username) AS operator, oe.id AS operator_employee_id, oe.avatar_key AS operator_avatar_key FROM approval_event e JOIN document_revision r ON r.id = e.revision_id JOIN work_document d ON d.id = r.document_id JOIN account a ON a.id = d.owner_id LEFT JOIN employee ea ON ea.id = a.employee_id LEFT JOIN account oa ON oa.id = d.updated_by LEFT JOIN employee oe ON oe.id = oa.employee_id WHERE e.actor_id = #{account} AND e.action IN ('APPROVE', 'RETURN') AND e.id = (SELECT MAX(e2.id) FROM approval_event e2 JOIN document_revision r2 ON r2.id = e2.revision_id WHERE r2.document_id = d.id AND e2.actor_id = #{account} AND e2.action IN ('APPROVE', 'RETURN')) ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.id DESC
